title: Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection - CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection - Evaluating Responses - Low Bids
subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: A bidder submits a price that is drastically lower than the agency's engineer estimate and 50% lower than the next competitor. What is the primary risk to the public agency if it blindly awards to this abnormally low bid?
options: The agency will face audits for saving too much money
The vendor may realize their error and default, walk off the job, or attempt to cut corners on quality to mitigate their financial losses
The procurement officer's salary will be reduced
The vendor will automatically be reclassified as a sole source
questions.explain: Abnormally low bids carry severe risk of non-performance. A vendor who bids too low to cover costs is highly likely to default or deliver substandard work, ultimately costing the agency more in delays and re-bidding.
